author: Matt Lenzie
upstream_repository_access: Private; public reproducibility begins from included aggregate inputs.json
scope: The approval rate in a matched 253-authority panel fell from 71.96% in Q3 2025 to 68.38% in Q3 2026. A symmetric decomposition attributes -3.289 percentage points to within-region changes and -0.293 points to regional composition, summing to -3.582 points. The direction survives extreme assignment of recorded unknown outcomes: 2026 bounds are 67.37-68.84%, versus 71.15-72.28% for 2025. These are deterministic sensitivity bounds, not confidence intervals. This panel is not a complete national planning census.
reproduction: python reproduce.py --output reproduced; standard library only. Does not rebuild upstream ETL or independently recalculate retained source statistics.
no_private_entities: No lender names, security trustees, company numbers, borrower records, addresses or transaction-level records included.
